title: genista trigonelloides
intro: Genista trigonelloides, commonly known as Lesser Spurred Genista or Thorny Spurred Genista, is a perennial shrub in the pea family Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin issues, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Genista trigonelloides include its ability to calm digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and act as a diuretic. The plant contains bioactive constituents like isoflavones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and potential side effects.
